en: Psalms 72

p.src: By Solomon.

en: By Solomon.
u.src: By Solomon.

p.src: 1  God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

en: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
u.src: 1  God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

p.src: 2  He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
u.src: 2  He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

p.src: 3  The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

en: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
u.src: 3  The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

p.src: 4  He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

en: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
u.src: 4  He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

p.src: 5  They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

en: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
u.src: 5  They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

p.src: 6  He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

en: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
u.src: 6  He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

p.src: 7  In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

en: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
u.src: 7  In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

p.src: 8  He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
u.src: 8  He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

p.src: 9  Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

en: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
u.src: 9  Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

p.src: 10  The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

en: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
u.src: 10  The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

p.src: 11  Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

en: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
u.src: 11  Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

p.src: 12  For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

en: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
u.src: 12  For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

p.src: 13  He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

en: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
u.src: 13  He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

p.src: 14  He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

en: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
u.src: 14  He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

p.src: 15  He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

en: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.
u.src: 15  He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

p.src: 16  Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

en: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
u.src: 16  Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

p.src: 17  His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

en: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
u.src: 17  His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

p.src: 18  Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

en: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
u.src: 18  Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

p.src: 19  Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

en: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
u.src: 19  Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

p.src: 20  This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

en: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
u.src: 20  This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
